name: Cosmic
oneLiner: Deep-space dark theme with neon accents and spatial depth that suggests a world beyond the viewport.

notes: Decorative glow adds no contrast — keep body copy on the text role and glass panels at a surface opacity that still clears 4.5:1.
The light scheme is a daytime variant: keep the violet but drop the glow and lower the blur.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-full); background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(131, 100, 255, 0.30)

outline.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(131, 100, 255, 0.40); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-full); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: var(--uiux-color-text)

default.base: padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(131, 100, 255, 0.22); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-lg); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(14px)
font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)
font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--uiux-color-text)
height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(131, 100, 255, 0.30); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-full); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: var(--uiux-color-text)
default.focusVisible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(131, 100, 255, 0.20); outline: none

do: Keep the page deep and the light local: one radial glow behind the hero, never across the whole viewport.
Use fully round pill controls and 20px containers — the radii are part of the language.
Let type do the work: large light-weight headings, wide-tracked uppercase labels.
dont: Do not add a second saturated hue; violet carries the identity.
Do not put small text directly on the gradient without a surface behind it.
Do not animate the background; it competes with content.
antiPatterns: White text at 40% opacity for secondary copy.
